mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_key (user_id, endpoint, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, response_http_status, response_body, lease_expires_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{record.userId}, #{record.endpoint}, #{record.idempotencyKey}, #{record.requestHash}, #{record.status}, #{record.responseHttpStatus}, #{record.responseBody}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND))
